decision: Launch Nymrel Agent as a public stateless multi-model routing product with customer-local provider execution and a separately scoped managed implementation service.
customer_impact: Developers get an immediately usable routing API, CLI, and MCP surface without handing Nymrel provider credentials or prompt data.
simplicity_check: One deterministic routing core powers every surface; hosted execution, accounts, billing, and customer-data custody are excluded from the initial launch.
revenue_impact: Creates a credible Nymrel product-led entry point and an on-request implementation and optimization service without inventing pricing.
risks: Public API abuse; routing misconfiguration; accidental credential or prompt custody; premature compatibility claims.
mitigations: Stateless route-only public API, bounded inputs, explicit public-route register, redacted logs, deterministic receipts, local-only execution adapters, canary deployment, rollback-ready releases.
confidence_reason: The Phase 0 router and receipt contracts were independently accepted, the production surface stays stateless, and all sensitive execution remains opt-in and local.
